themes.note: Six printings of the same roles, from src/styles/tokens.css. Frontmatter colors are Harbor (the default and the light 'auto' choice); 'auto' resolves to Night when the device is dark.

display.purpose: Landing hero title beside its numeral; 42px on phone, 76px desktop, max 15ch.

title.purpose: Song title in the editor as a bare input; 28px on phone, 34px desktop.

numeral.purpose: Two-digit accent track number in creation order; 26px in the notebook, 34/42px in the editor.

headword.purpose: The finished word heading the suggestion panel; also the wordmark.

lyric.purpose: The writing surface; 18px phone, 19px desktop, 1.8 leading, max 48rem.

row-title.purpose: Notebook track titles and suggested words (weight-ranked).

body.purpose: Running text and fields (16px prevents iOS zoom).

body-sm.purpose: Menu items, nav items, secondary copy.

credit.purpose: The credit line under a title: author and themes.

control.purpose: Uppercase tracked buttons and tabs; 12px in small buttons and the desktop category index.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked field labels and in-dialog section names. Never a decorative line above a heading.

shadows.name: rule-tab-selected
shadows.purpose: Selected tab underline (panel-accent inside the slab). A printed rule, not elevation.

shadows.name: rule-field-focus
shadows.purpose: Thickens a focused field's bottom rule to 3px.

shadows.name: mark-checked
shadows.purpose: Leaves a sleeve gap inside a checked box or radio.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour, border and underline changes on buttons, tabs, fields and checks.

motion.name: sheet
motion.purpose: Suggestion sheet height between peek, half and full (phone only).

motion.name: headword-in
motion.purpose: Headword lifts 0.3em and fades from 45% opacity when a new word is finished.

motion.name: loading-run
motion.purpose: Ink segment running along the loading rule.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All of the above switch off under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: At or below: word grid drops to two columns.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Ink rail replaces the tab bar; suggestion sheet docks right (320px).

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Rail 240px, dock 416px, categories as a two-column index.

components.name: Ink Button
components.description: Default primary action: ink fill, sleeve text, uppercase, square.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.07em; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #a8321c); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ink { background: var(--ink, #10243a); color: var(--sleeve, #d3e4ee); } .ds-btn-ink:hover { background: var(--ink-2, #3c5268); }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: The single most important call on a screen; reverses to ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 18px; border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; background: var(--accent, #a8321c); color: var(--on-accent, #ffffff); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.07em; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: var(--ink, #10243a); color: var(--sleeve, #d3e4ee); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #a8321c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Line Button
components.description: Secondary action: 1.5px ink outline, sleeve-2 wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-line { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 18px; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #10243a); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #10243a); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.07em; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-line:hover { background: var(--sleeve-2, #c3d8e5); } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #a8321c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Sleeve-2 fill with a 1.5px ink bottom rule; focus turns the rule accent and thickens it.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; line-height: 1.3; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-2, #3c5268); } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #10243a); border-radius: 0; background: var(--sleeve-2, #c3d8e5); color: var(--ink, #10243a); caret-color: var(--accent, #a8321c); font: inherit; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.4; outline: none; transition: border-color 120ms ease-out, box-shadow 120ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-2, #3c5268); opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus { border-bottom-color: var(--accent, #a8321c); box-shadow: inset 0 -1.5px 0 var(--accent, #a8321c); }

components.name: Song View Tabs
components.description: Uppercase tabs on a 1.5px ink rule; the selected tab carries a 3px accent underline.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 20px; border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #10243a); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-2, #3c5268); cursor: pointer; transition: color 120ms ease-out, box-shadow 120ms ease-out; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, #10243a); } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--ink, #10243a); box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 var(--accent, #a8321c); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #a8321c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Square outlined tag; pressed reverses to ink. Never a pill.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; height: 26px; align-items: center; padding: 0 8px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-2, #3c5268); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tag[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink, #10243a); border-color: var(--ink, #10243a); color: var(--sleeve, #d3e4ee); } .ds-tag:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #a8321c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Track Row
components.description: A notebook entry as a ruled tracklist row: accent numeral, bold title, first line, credits.
components.html:
• 01

    Night Bus

    Streetlights counting down the blocks

    #city #winter

  • 02

    Harbour Lights

    Nothing written yet.
components.css: .ds-tracks { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--ink, #10243a); } .ds-track { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; min-height: 76px; padding: 12px 4px 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #9db7c9); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-track:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sleeve-2, #c3d8e5) 60%, transparent); } .ds-num { width: 36px; flex: none; padding-top: 2px; text-align: right; font-size: 26px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--accent, #a8321c); } .ds-track-title { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-track-line { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-2, #3c5268); } .ds-track-credit { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-2, #3c5268); }

components.name: Suggestion Panel
components.description: The reversed ink slab: headword, uppercase category tabs with counts, weight-ranked word rows in fixed columns.
components.html: tonight
components.css: .ds-panel { background: var(--panel, #10243a); color: var(--on-panel, #e3eef4); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif); padding-bottom: 4px; } .ds-headword { margin: 0; padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.01em; animation: ds-head-in 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } @keyframes ds-head-in { from { opacity: 0.45; transform: translateY(0.3em); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } } .ds-ptabs { display: flex; gap: 20px; padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--panel-rule, #2a4058); } .ds-ptab { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--on-panel-2, #a9c0d0); cursor: pointer; transition: color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-ptab span { font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ptab:hover { color: var(--on-panel, #e3eef4); } .ds-ptab[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--on-panel, #e3eef4); box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 var(--panel-accent, #f08a6e); } .ds-words { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); padding-top: 4px; } .ds-word { display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; background: none; font: inherit; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.25; text-align: left; color: var(--on-panel, #e3eef4); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-word:hover { background: var(--panel-2, #1a3049); } .ds-word:focus-visible, .ds-ptab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--panel-accent, #f08a6e); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-w0 { font-weight: 700; } .ds-w1 { font-weight: 500; } .ds-w2 { font-weight: 400; color: var(--on-panel-2, #a9c0d0); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-headword { animation: none; } }

components.name: Phone Tab Bar
components.description: Ink slab bottom navigation; active item on-panel with a panel-accent icon.
components.html: WriteNotebook
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); background: var(--panel, #10243a); border-top: 1px solid var(--panel-rule, #2a4058); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-tabbar-item { display: flex; height: 58px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--on-panel-2, #a9c0d0); text-decoration: none; } .ds-tabbar-item svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; } .ds-tabbar-item[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--on-panel, #e3eef4); } .ds-tabbar-item[aria-current="page"] svg { color: var(--panel-accent, #f08a6e); } .ds-tabbar-item:hover { color: var(--on-panel, #e3eef4); } .ds-tabbar-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--panel-accent, #f08a6e); outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview:
Every song is a track printed on an album's inner sleeve: a track number, a bold title, a small credit line, then the lyric. The ground is one flat sleeve colour, the type is sleeve ink, and a single printed accent marks whatever is active. The suggestion panel, the tab bar, the desktop rail and the menus are a solid slab of ink with sleeve-coloured type reversed out of it. Nothing floats; structure comes from printed rules and that one reversal.

The system is quiet so the writer's words carry the page. Lyrics sit in calm regular-weight text at a generous 1.8 leading; chrome speaks in small uppercase tracked labels; only titles and track numerals are set heavy. Density is phone-first: 44px touch rows everywhere, a 16px page gutter, and the same layout grows into a rail-editor-dock arrangement on desktop rather than being restyled.

A theme is a different printing of the same sleeve. Six printings ship (Harbor, Lilac, Mint, Newsprint, Night, Forest); components only ever read the semantic roles, so every theme re-colours the same rules, slab and accent. The build rejects the grey-chrome notes app with a blue accent and pill chips.
keyCharacteristics: Flat sleeve ground, sleeve ink, one printed accent per printing.
A reversed ink slab for the suggestion panel, tab bar, desktop rail and menus.
Archivo throughout: 800 for titles and numerals, uppercase tracked 700 for controls and labels, 400 for lyrics.
Rules instead of boxes; square corners; no cast shadows.
Accent track numerals (two digits, zero-padded, creation order) anchor every song.
44px minimum touch target on every interactive row.

rules.name: The One Printed Accent Rule
rules.body: A printing has exactly one accent (plus its slab reprint). It marks state and the track numeral; it is never a decorative fill, background tint or second brand colour.

rules.name: The Every Printing Is AA Rule
rules.body: ink, ink-2 and accent against sleeve, and on-panel, on-panel-2 and panel-accent against panel, are each at least 4.5:1 in every theme. A new printing ships only when all six pairs pass.

rules.name: The Roles Not Values Rule
rules.body: Components read semantic roles (`--sleeve`, `--ink`, `--panel`...) only. A hex inside a component is a bug; a theme is nothing but a block of role values.

rules.name: The Weight Carries Rank Rule
rules.body: Size steps are few; rank is weight. 800 is reserved for titles, numerals, the headword and the wordmark; lyrics are always 400.

rules.name: The Uppercase Means Control Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked type labels a control or a field. It is not used as a decorative line above a heading.

rules.name: The Thumb Holds Still Rule
rules.body: Anything under the writer's thumb keeps its cell when content changes: tab positions, word columns, and the panel's height stay fixed; only the words swap.

rules.name: The No Cast Shadow Rule
rules.body: No outer or drop shadows, no glows, no blur at any state. Inset rules drawn with box-shadow are permitted because they are lines, not elevation.

rules.name: The Rules Not Boxes Rule
rules.body: Group with a rule and space before reaching for a border on four sides. Four-sided borders are reserved for controls (outlined buttons, checks, switches, tags) and for the dialog and menu edges.

dos: Do read only semantic roles in components so all six printings stay correct.
Do mark exactly the active thing with the accent: selected tab underline, focus ring, track numeral, pinned state.
Do put suggestions, navigation and menus on the reversed ink slab, and everything else on the flat sleeve.
Do set titles and numerals at 800, lyrics at 400 with 1.8 leading, and controls in uppercase 700 at 0.07-0.08em.
Do keep every interactive row at least 44px tall and fields at 16px text.
Do separate with 1px or 1.5px rules; keep corners square.
Do give every new song view its two-digit accent track numeral from creation order.
Do honour reduced motion: the sheet, headword lift, loading run and control transitions all switch off.
donts: Don't add drop shadows, glows or blur; distinguish floating surfaces with an ink edge instead.
Don't round corners or make pill chips; the radio mark is the only circle.
Don't use gradients as fills; they are allowed only to draw small shapes (chevron, knob) or fade an overflow edge.
Don't introduce a second accent or tint surfaces with the accent.
Don't add a second typeface or set lyrics in a heavy weight.
Don't set an uppercase tracked line above a heading as decoration; uppercase labels name controls and fields.
Don't let a content change move a tab, column or the panel height under the writer's thumb.
Don't wrap notes or settings groups in cards; use ruled rows.
